items: **UPI/RuPay subsidy FY27**: ₹2,000 crore (down 8.9% from FY26's ₹2,196.21 crore; FY24 peak ₹3,631 crore)
**Disinvestment target FY27**: ₹80,000 crore (vs ₹33,837 crore RE for FY26) — banks on IDBI Bank, LIC stake sales
**PMAY-U 2.0 (BLC component)**: target raised 350% to 5,00,000 homes FY27 (from 1,10,000 FY26); outlay ₹18,625 crore (+148%)
**Khelo India Mission**: highest-ever allocation ₹4,479.88 crore; scheme itself gets ₹924.35 crore
**NICDIT**: ₹3,000 crore; new Integrated East Coast Industrial Corridor (Durgapur-anchored)
**Rare Earth Corridors**: Odisha, Kerala, AP, Tamil Nadu — 🔄 feeds into the [Feb] PIB rare-earth-magnets scheme (Section 9)
**Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS)** — 🔄 feeds into [Feb] Bharat Container Shipping Line MoU (Section 5)
